intro: Create a Stream Launch countdown in six short sections. It can follow exact program-scene names automatically, with Streamer.bot controls retained as manual fallbacks.

sections.title: 1. Countdown and scene
sections.description: Choose the normal duration and the exact program scene that should run it. At least one second is required.

sections.title: 2. Completion
sections.description: Show a custom message and optionally play one core-generated tone when the timer reaches zero.

sections.title: 3. Optional scene switch
sections.description: At zero, run one triggerless Streamer.bot action that you approve below. That action can switch OBS, Streamlabs Desktop, Meld, or perform another creator-owned transition.
sections.notice: Enable this only after adding exactly one safe target under Approved Streamer.bot actions. Complete Now is preview-only and never runs the target action.

sections.title: 4. Overlay layout
sections.description: Choose the label, font, background behavior, progress bar, and urgency thresholds.

sections.title: 5. Overlay colors
sections.description: Customize the background, accent, text, warning, critical, running, and border colors.

sections.title: 6. Optional manual controls
sections.description: Import the separate Streamer.bot package when you want creator hotkeys, Stream Deck buttons, or a completion action.
sections.notice: Scene matching is handled directly by StreamBridge, so do not attach OBS scene triggers to Start or Stop. Start resumes an in-progress timer without resetting it. Set & Start uses its editable countdownSeconds argument for a one-off duration. Complete Now previews the completion message and tone without switching scenes.
